title: Lower price with technical and lead-time risk
decision_message: Lower unit price remains conditional because technical evidence is incomplete and lead-time risk is elevated.

title: Material reduction with qualification threshold
decision_message: Material reduction creates potential savings but requires complete compression, transport and line qualification.

title: Higher quoted price with lower total annualized cost
decision_message: The proposal has a higher quoted unit price than the cheapest option but stronger pallet utilization, lower risk and a better total-cost position.
